summary.intent: Run `/gsd-plan-phase 65` end-to-end to produce PLAN.md files for Phase 65 (SDK Write-Chain, Bin Re-link, and Invite Claim), including research, planning, and verification.
summary.outcome: Research phase completed — `65-RESEARCH.md` and `65-VALIDATION.md` committed; critical gap (`sealChildWriteKey`/`unsealChildWriteKey` missing) and two planner open questions surfaced. Session ended before the planner was spawned, so PLAN.md files were not yet created.

repo: `sealChildWriteKey`/`unsealChildWriteKey` (AAD role 0x04) are entirely absent from `packages/core/src/node/seal.ts` — only the read equivalents (role 0x02) exist. Phase 65 must add them as its first task; everything in the write-chain is blocked on this.
`claimInviteReadKey` is fully implemented in `packages/sdk-core/src/share/grant.ts` — Phase 65 invite-claim work is service wiring only, not a primitive reimplementation.

`originalFolderKeyEncrypted` is absent from the `BinEntry` type (removed in Phase 62) but still appears in test fixtures at `bin.test.ts:724` and `bin.test.ts:1063`, which may cause confusion during bin restore implementation.

`SharedWriteContext` currently exposes raw `folderKey: Uint8Array` and `ipnsPrivateKey: Uint8Array` directly — in the write-body model, `ipnsPrivateKey` comes from unsealing the write-body, so the type needs reshaping before `shared-write.ts` can be implemented.
`.planning/` is excluded from the pre-commit markdownlint hook (`--ignore .planning`), so markdown lint errors in planning docs are cosmetic-only and never block commits.
The drift pre-check (§5.65) returned entirely non-code noise (config files, `.learnings/`, `landing/`, husky hooks) — none touching the write-chain surface; it was non-blocking.

The GSD `plan-phase` orchestrator scaffolds `VALIDATION.md` before spawning the planner when RESEARCH.md contains a `Validation Architecture` section (Nyquist gate §5.5). The researcher commits RESEARCH.md itself; the orchestrator owns VALIDATION.md.

code.finding: PLACEHOLDER_WRITE_KEY (`new Uint8Array(32)`) is passed to `sealNode` inside `rotateOne` at L550 and L594. Phase 65 must thread the real `writeKey` (derived from write-body unseal) here or the write-body of any rotated node will be silently corrupted.
`nodeKeySource` seam locations where the real writeKey must be wired in (confirmed present alongside the Phase-64 'Phase 65 derives from write-body' comments).
`claimInviteReadKey` is fully implemented here. Phase 65 invite-claim task is wiring + deleting sdk-layer `encryptedChildKeys` consumption, not implementing the primitive.
All exports are fully stubbed — each throws `Error('not implemented — phase 65 (write-chain)')`. This is the primary implementation target for the write-chain.
`originalFolderKeyEncrypted` still referenced in test fixtures at these lines despite being removed from the `BinEntry` type. Restore implementation will need to reconcile this.

workflow: The GSD researcher subagent commits its own output file (RESEARCH.md) — the orchestrator should not restage or re-commit it; checking `git status` after the researcher returns will show it already committed.

When a VALIDATION.md template contains emphasis on a legend line (e.g., `**Note:**`), markdownlint MD036 fires even though `.planning/` is excluded from the pre-commit hook — fix proactively to keep docs clean.
Researcher model is sonnet, planner is opus, checker is sonnet — the model tier ladder is encoded in the phase's `gsd.query commit` config, not hardcoded in the workflow.

friction: MD036 markdownlint warning on a template legend line in the freshly scaffolded VALIDATION.md required a manual edit before commit, even though `.planning/` is excluded from the pre-commit hook.
